lines.say: Almost 40 years after Tetris was made, a 13-year-old finally beat it.
Tetris was created in 1984 by Alexey Pajitnov, a software engineer in Moscow.
The name mixes tetra, meaning four, with his favorite sport, tennis.
In 1989, it came packed in with the Game Boy, and that version sold 35 million copies.
That same year, Nintendo and Tengen fought in court over the NES rights. Nintendo won, and Tengen's version was pulled.
Then in 2023, 13-year-old Willis Gibson played NES Tetris until the game crashed, the first person ever to do it.
